title: Result
description: An implication: premises entail a principle or False. A False conclusion records incompatibility. Counterexamples to implications are recorded as models.

conclusion.description: A principle id, or false (YAML boolean false or the string "false") for incompatible premises. False is a logical constant, not a principle.

was_conjectured.description: Historical marker for a record that began as a conjecture. It does not change proof status or supply inference evidence.

source_id.description: Mathematical source in topic.source_catalog; credit adaptations or alternative proofs separately. Use misc for original one-off work. Drives source filters and badges.

provenance.description: Origin of the mathematical result or model, not authorship of its database transcription.

lean.description: none: no Lean statement. stated: the generated statement elaborates; its proof remains pending. verified: a checked proof of the generated statement using only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. Only pmap lean-check --update may set verified.

recorded_by.description: Who transcribed or translated the database record, separately from the mathematical author.

source_names.description: Short display names, one per sources entry in the same order; full citations remain in sources.

references.description: References to papers.yaml; roles distinguish definition origins and background from direct proofs.

changes.description: Dated revision log. Append an entry whenever a record gains content after its certificate date (new verified properties, an added proof, a corrected statement). The Changes tab lists each entry under its own date; certificate.date stays the record's original date.

by.description: Who supplied the revision's content (author or agent, with date if useful).

summary.description: What changed and why, in one or two sentences.
